# README stand-ins

`robot.qb` is written for Margo (Apache-2.0), byte by byte from the Qubicle Binary description (Minddesk wiki, "Qubicle
Constructor 1: Data Exchange With Qubicle Binary", 2013): version 1.1.0.0, RGBA, right handed, uncompressed, two matrices
(`Body` 4 x 5 x 3, `Head` 4 x 3 x 3). It is served as `/models/robot.qb` to the voxel-files README example.
